name: d12x_uses_x2_x1
subs: const float d12x = fsub(a, x2, x1);
const float d12x = fsub(a, x2, x0);

name: d01y_uses_y1_y0
subs: const float d01y = fsub(a, y1, y0);
const float d01y = fsub(a, y2, y0);

name: p_a_d01y_d12x
subs: const float p_a = fmul(a, d01y, d12x);
const float p_a = fmul(a, d01y, d12y);

name: p_b_d01x_d12y
subs: const float p_b = fmul(a, d01x, d12y);
const float p_b = fmul(a, d01x, d12x);

name: area_minus_not_plus
subs: const float area = fsub(a, p_a, p_b);
const float area = fop(a, p_a, p_b, '+');

name: y0_uses_fr3
subs: const float x0 = a->fr[4], y0 = a->fr[5];
const float x0 = a->fr[4], y0 = a->fr[3];
